summary: Attach only the offline and netinst ISOs and their SHA-256 sidecars to forge releases; publish required source, manifests and netinst packages through the website download tree.

guide.reason: The forge asset list, required website deployment and publication order change the maintainer's release steps.

api.reason: Release CI and installer artifact hosting change no client-facing API, Controller operation, Core command or observed-state/result contract.

roadmap.reason: This changes artifact placement and release checks, not milestone status.

state.reason: No new pool or Controller state is stored.

verification.method: The new four-asset and required-deployment regression checks failed before the workflow change and passed afterward. The release test discovery passed 44 tests; the CI-security and controller-package checks passed 15 tests; the documentation worktree check and repository privacy test passed. No forge release or ISO build was performed.
